products_soft_delete_metadata_consistent.name: products_soft_delete_metadata_consistent
products_soft_delete_metadata_consistent.value:
(
        "products"."soft_deleted_at" is null
        and "products"."soft_deleted_by_user_id" is null
        and "products"."soft_delete_reason" is null
      ) or (
        "products"."soft_deleted_at" is not null
        and "products"."soft_deleted_by_user_id" is not null
        and length(btrim("products"."soft_delete_reason")) > 0
      )

sales_status_cancellation_consistent.name: sales_status_cancellation_consistent
sales_status_cancellation_consistent.value: ("sales"."status" = 'completed' and "sales"."cancelled_at" is null and "sales"."cancelled_on" is null) or ("sales"."status" = 'cancelled' and "sales"."cancelled_at" is not null and "sales"."cancelled_on" is not null)
